objective: One Classic Normal experiment: link Scout information gathering to a legal follow-up attack whose value depends on the concealed rank.
design: Replace blanket Scout probe credit with a bounded public-inventory value of deciding whether to attack after a Scout loss. Require a different friendly non-Scout with a currently legal attack on that target; use only ranks for which the Scout dies and the defender remains. Credit is the weighted value of choosing attack/abstain after disclosure minus choosing before disclosure, divided by all plausible target ranks. Discard values below the Scout material cost; cap at 80. Use the same value in Scout objective selection. Other ranks, mission cooperation, other difficulties and variants retain their existing scoring.
development_gate: At least 52% against production, nonnegative matched league point difference, all unchanged tactics and public-information invariance tests pass. Freeze before saved strength games. No tuning after games.
validation_gate: Fresh paired 95% predecessor score interval wholly above 50% and fresh matched league block 95% difference wholly above zero; no tactical/fairness regressions. An X16 replacement also requires native/banked parity, memory/stack/timing/save/distribution gates. Failure is a completed rejected experiment, not grounds for another design.
limits: One candidate design, no new teacher or student fit. Review and diagnostic cases are quarantined from strength evidence. Preserve every saved tournament and immutable source recipe.
